content: connect-go: define service in protobuf, generates type-safe Go server/client. Servers accept Connect, gRPC, and gRPC-Web protocols simultaneously on one http.Handler with no extra config; interoperates with grpcurl/grpc-go clients over TLS without a translating proxy. Interceptors (middleware-equivalent) are the place for cross-cutting concerns (auth header propagation, tracing, logging).
